column1: # balance-model v2 (D475): drafted-context card values. census = the census fit's value on the card's scale; drafted = drafted games alone (ridge to 0, lambda 800); blend = alpha x census + the card's own term, ridge-shrunk toward it (lambda 1600; alpha legacy 0.948, pauper 0.827), the value v2 predicts with; sd/lo/hi its draft-bootstrap with the census's replicates as the prior.
